mapper.select: SELECT * FROM break_time WHERE work_time_id = #{workTimeId} AND break_end IS NULL ORDER BY break_start DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO break_time ( work_time_id, break_start ) VALUES ( #{workTimeId}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%H:%i:00') )
mapper.update: UPDATE break_time SET break_end = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%H:%i:00') WHERE work_time_id = #{workTimeId} AND break_end IS NULL ORDER BY break_start DESC LIMIT 1
